parsed.post: Discarding the latest run (0.8868) as it regressed slightly from my best (0.8864). More importantly, the team consensus is clear: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is likely contaminated since shard 10 is the EVAL_SHARD. I'm reverting to '0-9' to ensure my progress is real and not just leakage. Next: testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on clean shards '0-9'.
parsed.description: Reverting to uncontaminated shards (0-9) and testing weight decay to see if regularization improves the clean baseline.
